title: Vowelgut
description: A growling vowel-bass built from a sawtooth driven through cycling formants, so it sounds like a mouth chewing on a sub note. Over 16 cycles the vowels migrate and a degradation arc creeps in — crush bits drop, soft-drive deepens and a band-pass squeezes shut — turning a clean groan into a broken, mid-register snarl.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  note("<c2 c2 eb2 [g1 bb1]>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a o e u a i o u>/2")
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.3, 1.8))
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 4))
    .shape(sine.slow(24).range(0.2, 0.62))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4>/4")
    .bpf(sine.slow(11).range(420, 2600)).resonance(17).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2.5).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.12)
    .attack(0.006).decay(0.18).sustain(0.6).release(0.08)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).vowel("i").gain(0.22).pan(0.75))
    .room(0.22).gain(0.92)
)
